products.justification: Made from virgin plastic, which is derived from fossil fuels, contributing to a high carbon footprint during production. While durable, its end-of-life often involves landfill or incineration, and recycling rates for such items can be low.

alternatives.name: Waste bin made from recycled plastic
alternatives.reason: Utilizes post-consumer or post-industrial plastic, reducing the demand for virgin materials and diverting waste from landfills.

alternatives.name: Metal waste bin (e.g., steel or aluminum)
alternatives.reason: Metals are highly durable and can be recycled multiple times without significant loss of quality, leading to a longer lifecycle and reduced virgin material extraction.

alternatives.name: Bamboo or sustainably sourced wood waste bin
alternatives.reason: Made from renewable resources that are biodegradable. If sourced responsibly, these materials have a lower environmental impact compared to fossil fuel-derived plastics.

products.justification: Made from virgin plastic, which is derived from fossil fuels and has an energy-intensive production process. While reusable, its end-of-life recycling is often limited, and it contributes to plastic waste and potential microplastic pollution.

alternatives.name: Metal bucket (e.g., galvanized steel or stainless steel)
alternatives.reason: More durable, longer lifespan, and highly recyclable at end-of-life without degradation of material quality.

alternatives.name: Bucket made from 100% post-consumer recycled plastic
alternatives.reason: Reduces demand for virgin plastic and utilizes existing plastic waste, lowering the overall environmental impact.
